queries_executed: SELECT * FROM operating_schedules WHERE is_active = true
SELECT slot_date, start_time FROM session_slots WHERE slot_date >= $1 AND slot_date <= $2
INSERT INTO session_slots ... ON CONFLICT (slot_date, start_time) DO UPDATE

verdict.root_cause: Sequential REST API round-trips in Next.js, not PostgreSQL query execution time.
verdict.primary_bottleneck: Executing 2-3 sequential Supabase fetch() calls on every page load to check existence.
verdict.recommended_fix: Decouple slot generation from page request, or move the entire logic into a single PL/pgSQL RPC to eliminate network waterfalls.
